meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 它会从代码库里提取业务领域知识——领域、业务流程和流程步骤,产出可交互的横向流程图,并在仪表盘里打开查看。若已有知识图谱,则直接从图谱中派生,不扫描文件。
howto.when: 当你执行 /understand-domain 命令时接管。已有知识图谱就直接派生,否则做一次轻量扫描;加 --full 可强制重新扫描。

say.text: 用 /understand-domain 提取这个项目的业务流程
say.note: 生成领域流程图并在仪表盘打开
忽略已有知识图谱,强制全新扫描

say.text: 按现有的知识图谱派生领域图

howto.what_en: It extracts business domain knowledge — domains, flows and process steps — from a codebase and produces an interactive horizontal flow graph in the dashboard. If a knowledge graph exists, it derives from it instead.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /understand-domain. If a knowledge graph already exists it derives domain knowledge from it; otherwise it runs a lightweight scan. Add --full to force a fresh scan.

say_en.text: Run /understand-domain to map this project's business flows
say_en.note: Generates a domain flow graph and opens the dashboard
Forces a fresh scan even if a knowledge graph exists

say_en.text: Derive the domain graph from the existing knowledge graph
